notes.title: All Our Broken Parts Joins the Anime Game Fest 2025
notes.notes:
[p]Hello Players,[/p][p]All Our Broken Parts, an adventure where you play as a cyber doctor repairing robots, is now holding an open Playtest on Steam.
[/p][p]In this game, you step into the role of a cybernetic robot doctor, using tools like screwdrivers and wire cutters to treat all kinds of patients. Listen to their emotions, open up their mechanical bodies, and decide whether to repair or alter them. Patients' fate lies in your hands.
[/p][p]In the dark concrete jungle, a mysterious illness is quietly spreading. As a doctor, you’ll encounter “professional cyborgs” of all kinds: illustrators, freight haulers, bartenders, and more. Hack into their emotional modules and experience the “signature currents” flowing through their circuitry. With annual inspections looming, every treatment you perform may determine whether they can survive. But your routine work will soon be interrupted by a bizarre “canned goods” sales competition, as the secrets of the robot city’s past and future gradually come to light.
[/p][p]Head over to the Steam store page now, click \[Join the Playtest], and experience life as a cyber doctor. Don’t forget to add the game to your Wishlist!

Playtest open time: September 2 - September 16[/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3473430/_All_Our_Broken_Parts/"][/dynamiclink][/p][p][/p]

notes.title: Cyberpunk Visual Novel All Our Broken Parts Steam Page Live Now
notes.notes: [p]Hello, doctors![/p][p][/p][p]We are Tin Bird Games, and our cyberpunk visual novel All Our Broken Parts steam page is now live! The game is scheduled for release in 2026—add it to your wishlist and support us![/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45652536/ab058e171b55fe5e9ddaa8fc01724874c5e796e7.jpg"][/img][/p][p]All Our Broken Parts is a point-and-click visual novel set in a cyberpunk world. You play as a cyber doctor, tasked with “treating” a wide variety of robotic patients. Open up their cranial and chest compartments to uncover the source of their issues. Listen, diagnose, heal—and witness the fates of many unique individuals. Piece together secrets of the past and future, and discover the truth behind what makes every robot one of a kind.[/p][p][/p][p]We’ll also be showcasing our latest demo and exclusive merch at G-FUSION Beijing on June 28–29. Come play the game, and don’t forget to share your valuable feedback![/p][p][/p]
